description:
Implement the bounded resumable harness required by the frozen dense-parity addendum without changing production selection.

## Background

The harness reuses canonical campaign support and separately reports allocated whole-`matvec`, scalar reference, selected production, candidate, and externally adapted observations. Its smoke validation is deterministic and non-timed: it validates cells, semantics, logging, resume, and output shape but cannot collect receipt samples. Every timed sample is queued only after the frozen addendum is committed and runs on the prepared host inside the benchmark window under the shared measurement contract.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The harness executes the frozen stride-boundary cells with output allocation included and validates exact parity results plus 0/1/63/64/65 bit-boundary semantics.
- [hard] REQ-02: Bounded runs resume without repeating completed cells and emit content-pinned protocol, addendum, executable, input, host, toolchain, route, and sample provenance.
- [hard] REQ-03: A deterministic non-timed release smoke validates cell generation, parity semantics, append-only logging, checkpoint/resume, and output schema while emitting zero receipt samples.
- [hard] REQ-04: Timed execution refuses unfrozen inputs and queues every sample only after the committed addendum exists for execution inside the prepared-host benchmark window under the contract.

## Notes

The scalar four-accumulator route is a semantic/reference arm, not a proposed public API.
title: Implement the dense-parity measurement harness
